383:t_3:28.en:
$n
「...I don't know what to do right now.」

383:t_3:29.en:
$n
「But no matter what it takes, I'll rescue Miss $$スズネ$$.」

383:t_3:30.en:
$$シン$$
「Looks like you've found your answer.」

383:t_3:31.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Whether we get shot or do the shooting comes second. We wanted to hear your resolve.」

383:t_3:33.en:
$$シン$$
「Yeah. We got lucky, and help came our way, so we managed somehow.」

383:t_3:34.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「That's why we wanted you to make up your mind, too. Now we can back you up with everything we've got.」

383:t_3:35.en:
$$竜馬$$
「No... we can't leave rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$ to $n alone.」

383:t_3:36.en:
$$甲児$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$ is the Volunteer Club's madonna, after all.」

383:t_3:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$, $$アマタ$$ and the others will get fired up about rescuing Miss $$スズネ$$, too, I bet.」

383:t_3:38.en:
$n
「Then we do it with everyone's strength. No matter what tricks $$バルビエル$$ pulls.」

383:t_3:39.en:
$$ティティ$$
「Now it's getting fun! Do your best, everyone!」

383:t_3:40.en:
$n
「(Not clinging to convenient hopes, and not lashing out in despair either... Just doing what I have to do...)」

383:t_3:41.en:
$n
「(Miss $$スズネ$$... For me, that means rescuing you.)」

383:t_3:45.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

383:t_3:46.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...That concludes $$バルビエル$$'s report.」

383:t_3:48.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「More options are better.」

383:t_3:49.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「So it comes down to a direct confrontation in the end...」

383:t_3:52.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「What about you, $$ストラウス$$?」

383:t_3:54.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Your interest already lies elsewhere...」

383:t_3:56.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Your sortie is approved. But don't overdo it.」

383:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand that what you feel, $$セツコ$$, is more than mere sympathy.」

383:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z, born of sadness... I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

383:t_10:10.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I wanted to know the root of the hatred inside $$バルビエル$$...」

383:t_10:11.en:
$$セツコ$$
「But if I learn it, I might not be able to fight anymore...」

383:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「There's no use arguing over possibilities. We'll deal with it when the time comes.」

383:t_10:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Who knows, that lout might even destroy himself on his own, without you lifting a finger, $$セツコ$$.」

383:t_10:14.en:
$$セツコ$$
「...Thank you, $$ＡＧ$$. I feel a little better.」

383:t_10:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'm glad my rather offhand advice proved useful.」

383:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(Sadness and hatred, $$セツコ$$ and $$バルビエル$$... What could it be that makes these two $$スフィア$$s so incompatible?)」

383:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(Even without Miss $$スズネ$$, $n can now draw out 100% of the $$ジェニオン$$'s current power.)」

383:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「(Now that it's come to this, I have no more doubts. I shall bet all my $$Ｚチップ$$ on $n...)」

383:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...So with my mind made up, all that's left is to do it! Another day of giving it my all... business, business!」

384:t_000:0.en:
$$田中司令$$
「$$ターミナル・ベース$$ has entered combat range.」

384:t_000:1.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To all units. There is no change from the operation we briefed in advance.」

384:t_000:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Resistance members, while we take on the enemy interception force, protect the townspeople and guide the evacuation.」

384:t_000:4.en:
$$レジスタンス$$
「We'll leave the $$サイデリアル$$ to you, $c!」

384:t_000:6.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Well, it's the big showdown. If we take this base, the battle in the northern Central Continent is pretty much decided.」

384:t_000:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$タケル$$... I'm counting on you to look after $n.」

384:t_000:8.en:
$$タケル$$
「I don't need any looking after.」

384:t_000:9.en:
$n
「I don't plan on holding you back. Let's work well together, $$タケル$$.」

384:t_000:11.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$タケル$$ and $n as a duo, huh.」

384:t_000:12.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A classic handsome super robot pilot and a cool type with a bit of a shadow over him! A duo like that gets me fired up! Burn, burn!」

384:t_000:13.en:
$$サザンカ$$
「No, no, $$ノノ$$! That one looks like a cool type with a bit of a shadow at first glance, but underneath he's a clueless dolt who can't read the room!」

384:t_000:17.en:
$$タケル$$
「Still, I never thought $n would be the one to propose teaming up.」

384:t_000:18.en:
$n
「During the last battle with the army of darkness, I sensed it instinctively...」

384:t_000:19.en:
$n
「That to get past the wall I've been feeling, I need your strength.」

384:t_000:20.en:
$$タケル$$
「I see... I'll do my best in my own way.」

384:t_000:21.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「All units, be careful. The interception force has appeared.」

384:t_001:1.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Coming out all by himself... So he's finally made up his mind, has he!」

384:t_001:2.en:
$$グラハム$$
「Be careful! Knowing that man... I'd say he has some scheme prepared!」

384:t_001:4.en:
$$ギルター$$
「The bitter gall you've made me swallow until now...! I'll repay it here, double... no, tenfold!」

384:t_001:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「The exaggeration typical of a third-rater.」

384:t_001:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「I'm sick of your face! Let's finish this quickly!」

384:t_001:7.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Can you keep up that bravado after seeing this?!」

384:t_002:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「What the heck is that?!」

384:t_002:1.en:
$$ロラン$$
「Scorpion venom...! It's the same as $$バルビエル$$'s!」

384:t_002:3.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Exactly! The hypnotic waves emitted from them rob humans of their reason and turn them into savage beasts!」
